run_video_attention_from_video: run DINO self-attention video generation from an input video file to produce attention heatmap video
run_video_attention_from_frames: run DINO self-attention video generation from a folder of pre-extracted image frames
run_video_only_from_attention: run video generation from a folder of existing attention images using the video_only flag
extract_frames_from_video: extract individual frames from a video file into a directory as numbered JPEG images
generate_attention_heatmaps: generate self-attention heatmap images from input frames using a pretrained DINO vision transformer model
